INSERT INTO requests.system_prompt_firing_rules
                (request_system_prompt_id, filter_rule_id, ord)
             SELECT rsp.id, u.rule_id, (u.ord - 1)::int
               FROM UNNEST($2::bigint[]) WITH ORDINALITY AS u(rule_id, ord)
               JOIN requests.system_prompts rsp ON rsp.request_id = $1
             WHERE NOT EXISTS (
                 SELECT 1 FROM requests.system_prompt_firing_rules f
                 WHERE f.request_system_prompt_id = rsp.id
                   AND f.ord = (u.ord - 1)::int
             )
